methods.name: place
methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;const spacer=c=>typeof c.flexes=="boolean";let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible||spacer(c))continue;line=Math.max(line,c.footprint()[crossSize]);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"&&!spacer(c)){const fc=f==null?c.footprint():f;const leadC=axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-fc[crossSize])/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-fc[crossSize];else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})
